status: Candidate 33 phase A (six layers), selected with NATIVE21_STACKUP=native-21/stackup-6L.json; native-21/stackup.json stays the four-layer board of record. JLCPCB JLC061622-1080A (6 layers, 1.6 mm, 2 oz outer and inner), from JLC's stackup API 2026-10-14 (jlc-stackups-6L-2oz-2oz-2026-10-14.json; matches gsuberland/jlcpcb_autogenerated_stackups raw_json 9c8b685). Thicknesses are JLC's; epsilon_r for 1080 (3.91) and the 0.30 mm core (4.41) are secondary (gsuberland transcription) [UNVERIFIED]; dielectric 3 is the thickness-weighted 1080/2116 average. Laminate not named by JLC (calculator assumes Nan Ya NP-155F); Shengyi S1000-2M TG170 is orderable on 6 layers and would name it.
source_of_truth: Native-21's single layer-stack source (stage 33 refactor, c33-six-layer/REFACTOR-PROOF.md). prototype-closure/pcb/build_native21.py writes the board's (layers) copper entries and (setup (stackup ...)) from it; native-21/layout/layers21.py exports CU / OUTER / INNER / KICAD_ID / T_UM / Z_MM / ADJ / PLANE_ROLE from it for the layout scripts, gates and physics models. 'layers' is the KiCad stackup, top to bottom; copper entries add kicad_id (KiCad 9/10 numbering: F.Cu 0, B.Cu 2, InN.Cu 2 + 2N) and z_mm.
z_mm_definition: Copper-centre depth below the top copper surface (top of F.Cu), mm; solder masks excluded. layers21.py recomputes it from the thicknesses (sum of everything above plus half the copper) and asserts the value stated here; the computed value is the one used, so the physics keeps the arithmetic of the former sheet_solver.LAYER_Z_MM table bit for bit.

plane_roles._comment: Candidate 33 phase A, plan A (c33-six-layer/PHASE-A.md): net -> the inner layer carrying its role plane. In1 and In2 keep the four-layer roles by region: In1 = hv_ret / leg_ret (bridge), n_ha / n_hb (high-side islands), n_ls (LS block), ocp_kelvin_p (protection), v3v3 (SELV); In2 = bus_p (bridge) / selv_gnd (SELV), so the bus_p / hv_ret pair is the 0.30 mm core (0.5 mm on four layers). In3 is a signal layer except under the bridge (bus_p image). In4 and In3 carry image_planes. n_ls also has a small heat-spread pour on In2 (U42); its plane is In1.

image_planes._comment: net -> layer that repeats the net's role-plane pours (patches21.add_stage33_images; cut 1 mm round runs of return-path-asserted nets that expect another return, and pieces without a via or through-hole pad of the net dropped). In4.Cu, 0.2215 mm under B.Cu, images In1's reference planes (v3v3 SELV, n_ha / n_hb / n_ls islands, ocp_kelvin_p protection), so B.Cu runs reference the same net as F.Cu runs over In1 and an F <-> B via is a same-net stitch. In3.Cu images In2's bus_p (0.292 mm under it): the bus copper doubles where In2 is pinched (task 04 BUS_P 1.40 -> 0.85 mOhm, c33 PHASE-A.md). hv_ret / leg_ret get no image, and In4 stays empty under the bridge, so sw_a / sw_b on B.Cu see no plane closer than In3 (0.58 mm, 0.44 mm on four layers).
